name: Cornetta Brauvel
original_name: コルネッタ＝ブラウベル
source:
The second princess of the Brauvel kingdom. Originally intended to be married off to a neighbouring kingdom, the arrangement was cancelled after her fiance perished from illness. Her presence is not welcomed by her surviving brothers who see her as a threat to their dynastic ambitions. Her faction is the weakest with no support from anyone at the start of the game.

Despite her plight, she is still a member of the Brauvel ruling family and has the authority to order public works and other administrative commands. She is ably supported by her circle of palace maids (comprised of the daughters of noble families) who are absolutely loyal to her.
